description: Restore / log-shipping ops view: Difference Restore inventory, lag by type (Full/Diff/Log), RPO gap trends, failed restore jobs, standby/state. Collector: mssql_restore.

targets.expr: count(mssql_restore_lag_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"} >= $lag_warn and mssql_restore_lag_seconds >= 0) or vector(0)
count(count by (instance, db) (mssql_restore_lag_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"})) or vector(0)

panels.description: DBs in standby/read-only restoring mode or with restore history in last 90 days.

targets.expr: max by (instance, db, state_desc) (mssql_restore_db_standby{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"})
max by (instance, db, state_desc) (mssql_restore_db_state{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"})

panels.title: Standby + State

panels.description: Mirrors Power BI Difference Restore: lag since backup_finish_date of last applied restore. Restore Lag = RPO gap proxy. -1 = none in last 90 days.

targets.expr: max by (instance, db, original_db, original_server, backup_type, recovery_model) (mssql_restore_lag_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"})
max by (instance, db, original_db, original_server, backup_type, recovery_model) (mssql_restore_backup_size_bytes{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"})
max by (instance, db, original_db, original_server, backup_type, recovery_model) (mssql_restore_throughput_mb_s{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"})
max by (instance, db, original_db, original_server, backup_type, recovery_model) (mssql_restore_gap_to_rpo_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"})
(time() - max by (instance, db, original_db, original_server, backup_type, recovery_model) (mssql_restore_lag_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"} >= 0)) * 1000
(time() - max by (instance, db, original_db, original_server, backup_type, recovery_model) (mssql_restore_age_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db"} >= 0)) * 1000

panels.title: Restore Status - Last Applied Backup per DB
Lag by Backup Type (Full / Diff / Log)

panels.description: Lag since backup_finish_date of last restore per backup type. Log lag is the primary log-shipping SLA indicator.

targets.expr: max by (instance, original_server, original_db, db) ((mssql_restore_last_by_type_lag_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db", backup_type="full"} >= 0) or ((mssql_restore_last_by_type_lag_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db", backup_type="full"} < 0) * 0 + (-1)))

max by (instance, original_server, original_db, db) ((mssql_restore_last_by_type_lag_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db", backup_type="diff"} >= 0) or ((mssql_restore_last_by_type_lag_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db", backup_type="diff"} < 0) * 0 + (-1)))

max by (instance, original_server, original_db, db) ((mssql_restore_last_by_type_lag_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db", backup_type="log"} >= 0) or ((mssql_restore_last_by_type_lag_seconds{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"$db", backup_type="log"} < 0) * 0 + (-1)))
